_note: THE EMAIL MAP (owner, 31 Oct 2026: "one Email Map page inside Boss OS, all businesses"). The ONE list of every automated email anything of hers sends, in every business, the fund included (her ruling: Boss OS may handle anything she wants). The Email Map page renders it; docs/OUTBOUND_EMAIL_MAP.md keeps the detailed audit of the Boss OS and side-business paths, and every Id there is a row here with the same owner (tests/emailMap.test.ts). A new sending path goes here in the same PR: the test fails on a sending file in boss-os that no row cites, and `npm run email-map:check` does the same for the other repos and the Mac's launchd jobs. Public repo: business sending addresses only; you are 'You'; never a customer, LP, prospect or investor name.
